Description
The Zwick Roell temperature chambers are good for use in R&D as the mechanical properties of materials are mainly tested in an extended temperature and climatic conditions in a safe and simple operation that conforms to CE construction and ergonomics. 
It is designed for the most commonly used range of temperatures and also offers a number of cooling mediums/refrigeration units The chamber is tailored to integrated test needs because they are either fixed mounted, mounted on guide rails or using a hydraulic jack that the enduser can provide. Pushing the chamber out of the test area when performing tests on long/high extension specimen at ambient temperatures allows you to utilize the test machine to its fullest capability.
